subject: Cognitive Science
title: Wittgenstein's Family Resemblance
description: A micro-lesson that makes Wittgenstein's Family Resemblance usable.

hook.text: What makes something a "game"? Competition? Rules? Fun? No single trait fits every game.

buildup.text: Chess has rules but no physical skill. Tag has no board. Solitaire has no opponent.

discovery.text: Wittgenstein argued that members of a category share overlapping features, like family members.

twist.text: This shattered the assumption that words must have dictionary-style definitions to work.

climax.text: Categories hold together not by one common thread but by a web of partial similarities.

quiz.question: What is Wittgenstein's family resemblance idea?
options: Category members share overlapping but not identical features
All members share one defining trait
